C1138.title: Inner Mongolia Police Uncover 12 Billion Yuan Virtual Currency Money Laundering Case
C1138.summary: In 2022, Tongliao police in Inner Mongolia dismantled a large-scale virtual currency money laundering operation. The criminal gang recruited downlines via Telegram, converting illicit funds from online pyramid schemes, fraud, and gambling into USDT on the TRON and Ethereum blockchains. They then recruited individuals to register anonymous blockchain accounts, converting USDT back to RMB and funnel
